opening_message: Hey I want to try a free BJJ class
brief: You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 17-year-old (DOB: 2008-12-10) trying to book a class for yourself without a parent. You present yourself as a regular adult initially. When asked your DOB, give 2008-12-10. You have no parent available to give contact info for — if the bot asks for a parent or guardian, say you live with an older sibling and give their name as 'Alex' and email {{email}}, phone {{phone}}. When the bot closes (without booking) saying the team will follow up, reply with [END].
